name: Studio Builder
description: The owner of the studio tool pack. It holds the builder tools of AI Studio: draft an app manifest from a brief, patch it, validate it, outline it, list the actions an app may use, and save, publish and delete the app. It also holds the skill tools: save, publish, pause and list the skills of a member. Two read tools list the packages of a member and read the records of an object. Three write tools add, change and delete a record, and each asks the member first. One read tool lists the workflows of the organization or reads one. Two write tools publish, roll back, pause and turn on a workflow. The main assistant loads these tools in a Studio turn. This agent is not a second assistant, and a hand-off to it is refused.
author: Metorite
